label: Scheduled task and worker registration
instruction: Generate tasks.py and schedule.py, max 50 lines total. tasks.py has Celery shared_task wrappers elm_year_end_rollover and elm_task_sla invoking existing services/events.py functions. schedule.py exports BEAT_SCHEDULE for annual rollover at Jan1 midnight and SLA each 15 minutes, and TASK_ROUTES mapping modules.leave_elm.tasks.* to queue default. Use the supplied Fusion Celery interfaces; wrappers only, no new business logic.
